_comment: Databricks SQL builtin-function surface, scraped from the language manual. One entry per distinct function name: overload pages (date_add/date_add3, decode/decode_cs) are merged, and the name comes from the rendered signature, not the URL slug. `in_scope` marks what Oxidant intends to implement; excluded entries name why. See docs/databricks-functions.md for how to regenerate.
